## LinkedIn profile lookup

This paid, read-only tool searches Crustdata's indexed professional-person dataset for one named person. It requires explicit approval for a maximum 0.30-credit search, ranks the returned candidates, and exposes only public professional fields. It never returns email addresses, phone numbers, contact records, or the raw provider payload.
